Package dev.relism.flash.ext.webdav.nio

Class NioDavHandler

java.lang.Object
dev.relism.flash.http.Handler
dev.relism.flash.http.RequestHandler
dev.relism.flash.ext.webdav.DavHandler
dev.relism.flash.ext.webdav.nio.NioDavHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
Bound
Direct Known Subclasses:
ClusteredNioDavHandler, StandaloneNioDavHandler
public abstract sealed class NioDavHandler extends DavHandler permits StandaloneNioDavHandler, ClusteredNioDavHandler
A WebDAV mount over a directory of any java.nio.file file system: the local disk, a zip file, an in-memory one. root(dev.relism.flash.http.Request) says which directory a request sees; it is created when missing.

Extend one of its two kinds, which say where the state of a directory lives (the bytes in use, uploads in progress, locks):

  • StandaloneNioDavHandler: one process serves the directory, and keeps its state in memory;
  • ClusteredNioDavHandler: several processes serve it, and keep its state in .dav under the root, which clients do not reach unless the handler shows it.

Dead properties are kept in the files' extended attributes (xattrs on Linux and macOS, alternate data streams on Windows); where the file system has none, in memory.
